player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered a repetitive loop between the Gallery, Media room, and Exercise room, repeatedly traversing the same edges without tracking visited nodes. I did not maintain a mental map of which rooms I had already entered. Next time, I will explicitly track the set of visited rooms. Upon entering a new room, I will immediately check if all previously visited neighbors have been explored; if so, I will backtrack to the last unexplored branch rather than returning to a room I have already fully processed. I will only say "DONE" when the set of visited rooms equals the total number of unique rooms encountered.
